text:
Nina (recruiter): Offer for Priet (Senior Infra) — candidate asking 2026-07-08 start, relocating from EU. Manager requests $6k sign-on, provisional uplift to midpoint+4%, and benefits active day 1. Can we route an exception?
Priya (people-ops): Please paste one-line ask + business reason + docs ETA.
Nina (recruiter): Ask: $6k one-time sign-on; +4% provisional uplift; benefits start on first day. Reason: counteroffer risk, critical hire; candidate can provide passport + address by 2026-06-30.
Rohan (hiring manager): Confirming business impact: hiring delay delays critical infra work by ~6 weeks. I approve sign-on from discretionary.
Elaine (comp): +4% needs comp review sign-off (policy: <=3% auto). Upload manager memo and budget approval. If justification strong I'll sign.
Tom (finance): Finance needs GL code and headcount confirmation; sign-on ok from hiring bucket. GL=5012? please confirm.
Maya (onboarding): Note: benefits feed needs 72h. For international starts we need verification docs before feed; otherwise coverage may be delayed.
LegalBot: For day-1 benefits we add clause: "Benefits eligibility begins on the employee start date subject to carrier rules and timely verification of required documents."
Priya (people-ops): Routing plan: Manager -> Comp (Elaine) -> Finance (Tom) -> People Ops final. Loop in Legal & Onboarding. Target decision by 2026-06-28 to meet start date.
Nina (recruiter): Uploaded manager memo and budget approval. Tagging @Elaine @Tom.
Elaine (comp): Reviewing memo; provisional sign-off likely if finance confirms run-rate. No committee needed under 7%.
Tom (finance): GL confirmed 5012, headcount open. Provisional finance ok pending tracker entry.
Priya (people-ops): Checklist: 1) manager memo (done) 2) comp sign-off (Elaine) 3) finance ok (Tom) 4) legal clause added 5) onboarding feed ready. Target 2026-06-28.
Nina (recruiter): Thanks all — will push candidate for docs and update here. :thumbsup:
